provenance: Official PBRT-v4 explosion scene; PBRT README attributes its NanoVDB volume to an OpenVDB sample conversion.
license_status: PBRT README and OpenVDB sample download page do not state a separate sample-data license. OpenVDB software MPL-2.0 must not be assumed to license this data. Kept as local downloaded reference data; redistribution rights are not asserted.
usage: Use only grid density for non-emissive smoke; ignore temperature and disable blackbody emission.
